## Identity & Disambiguation
Shreyash Santosh Mane (publicly known as Shreyash Mane, GitHub handle `shreyashmane-dev`) is a Computer Science and Engineering student at D.Y. Patil College of Engineering, Kolhapur, specializing in artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, full-stack software engineering, cybersecurity tools, and IoT systems.

## Core Focus Areas
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (Agentic AI, LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, Local LLMs)
- Full-Stack Software Engineering (React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, TypeScript)
- Developer Tools & Systems (SAST vulnerability scanners, local search engines, desktop environments)
- Hardware & IoT Engineering (ESP32, Arduino, RFID attendance, ultrasonic sensor monitoring)
